# Subway Builder - Berlin Map

---

## Description:
> Bring the subway to Berlin! Build a working subway network in the capital of Germany. Over 1.650.000 commuters want to go to their workplace and it's your job to get them there! Based on real-life demand data from [mobilithek.info](https://mobilithek.info/offers/767359761906577408) (Latest access: 6th July 2026).
## Features:
- **Size**: 45x40km / 1783.2 sq/km
- **Real data**: Real-world demand data from mobilithek.info, utilizing the official 1x1km statistical grid.
- **Real routes and volume**: Commuter routes and their volume are strictly derived from the statistical data of the German Government (BMV/Mobilithek), with routes generated via a gravity-weighted model favoring closer, higher-capacity building pairs.
- **Demand Accuracy**: Macro-level grid demand is paired exclusively with real OpenStreetMap (OSM) building data — every commuter route starts and ends on an actual OSM-tagged residential or job building, never a synthetic or invented location.
- **Performance Optimized**: Low-density routes with fewer than 10 commuters have been filtered out to keep simulation performance smooth.
- **In-Game data**: 1,670,599 residents | 1,670,699 jobs
data_source: BMV (mobilithek), (OMV - only for realdworld building locations mapping)
